tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Baseball Game Score Calculation

You are given a list of operations representing the scoring records of a baseball game. Each operation updates the score history according to the following rules:

**Constraints:**

        text+=parts[1]
    elif parts[0]=='2':
        history.append(text)
        text=text[:-int(parts[1])]
    elif parts[0]=='3':

from collections import defaultdict

tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()

freq = defaultdict(int)
group = defaultdict(list)

    if tokens[i] == "push":

        x = int(tokens[i+1])
        f = freq[x] + 1
        freq[x] = f

        if f > maxf:

        freq[x] -= 1

        if not group[maxf]:

import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(data[0]); arr = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
left  = [-1] * n   # index of nearest smaller on left
right = [n]  * n   # index of nearest smaller on right
stack = []
for i in range(n):
    while stack and arr[stack[-1]] >= arr[i]: stack.pop()
    left[i] = stack[-1] if stack else -1
    stack.append(i)
stack = []
for i in range(n-1,-1,-1):
    while stack and arr[stack[-1]] >= arr[i]: stack.pop()
    right[i] = stack[-1] if stack else n
    stack.append(i)
ans = [0] * (n + 2)
for i in range(n):
    w = right[i] - left[i] - 1
    ans[w] = max(ans[w], arr[i])
for w in range(n-1, 0, -1):
    ans[w] = max(ans[w], ans[w+1])
print(' '.join(map(str, ans[1:n+1])))
